name: LMU east service building and adjoining mapped lawn
qualification: BVV LoD2 fixes the five-wall service envelope, bevelled corner, 3.016m measured height and flat roof; DOP20 supplies the roof and ground pixels. OSM fixes the adjoining lawn and access-path centre lines. Façade finishes, coping/plinth sizes and path widths are estimates without a verified close exterior photo; no speculative openings or interiors. Tree candidates and crowns use DOP20/DOM20, with estimated branch and leaf arrangement. Neighbouring buildings and unmodeled equipment outside the bounded reconstruction remain protected. Native visual and collision acceptance is required.
